changelog:
New synced lyrics system: switch to Settings → Interaction → Media Player → Overlay Style → Full metadata to enable line-synced lyrics, playback progress, timing adjustment and the redesigned music interface.

The confusing Device Volume / Software Volume selector has been removed. Ava now uses unified media-volume behavior, fixing Portal hardware volume-key synchronization and unexpected volume increases after reconnecting or changing tracks.

Also fixes Sendspin FLAC decoding, stalled media progress and silent Streaming TTS. When no usable streamed audio arrives, Ava automatically falls back to URL playback. Cold-start, mDNS and Android 14+ service reliability are also improved.

Thanks @lone-baggie #106, @deergitseason #104 and @alexreddy78 #89.
